items.title: Signature Recontextualization: Mapping perturbational signatures across biological contexts
items.abstract_or_text: Perturbational transcriptomics is a powerful tool for understanding gene function and drug effects, yet predicting how perturbations manifest across different biological contexts remains a central challenge, limiting translation from model systems to clinically relevant tissues. Despite growing interest in this problem, benchmarking efforts have been hindered by inconsistent evaluation tasks, heterogeneous metrics, and limited assessment across perturbation types and biological systems. Here, we introduce a benchmarking framework for cross-context perturbation-signature prediction (a task we define as signature recontextualization), grounded in explicit definitions of the prediction task, target-data availability, and evaluation metrics centered on signature recovery. The framework evaluates prediction performance across three target-context data regimes: (1) control only, where only control profiles from the target context are measured; (2) low coverage, where a limited subset of perturbations in the target context are measured; and (3) high coverage, where most perturbations in the target context are measured. This design enables systematic assessment of how prediction performance depends on target-context sample size while providing a standardized basis for comparing methods. We evaluate newly developed projection-based (projectCor) and network-based (netProp) methods alongside deep learning-based foundation models (scGPT, STACK) and statistical baselines. The benchmark spans four diverse perturbational datasets: CRISPR knockdowns and drug perturbations in cell lines, plus in vivo chemical perturbations in rat tissues from DrugMatrix, extending evaluation beyond isolated cell-line models to tissue-level responses. Across tasks, projection and network propagation approaches show strong flexibility across perturbation types and biological contexts, and in several cases match or exceed the performance of deep learning and foundation models, suggesting that model complexity does not inherently improve cross-context generalization. We further show that perturbation predictability varies substantially with pathway conservation, transcriptional response strength, and baseline similarity between source and target contexts. All datasets, methods, and evaluation utilities are released as an open-source R package (sigRecon), providing a foundation for reproducible benchmarking and future method development.
items.summary_zh: 提出 signature recontextualization 基准，系统比较跨生物学情境预测扰动转录组特征的方法，并发布 sigRecon 开源 R 包。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将 CRISPR、药物、细胞系与大鼠体内组织扰动纳入统一评测，显示较简单的投影与网络传播方法在若干任务中可匹配或超过基础模型，为可复现的跨情境扰动预测提供了共同基准。
items.abstract_zh: 扰动转录组学是理解基因功能和药物效应的有力工具；然而，预测扰动如何在不同生物学情境中表现仍是一项核心挑战，限制了从模型系统向临床相关组织的转化。尽管人们对此问题的兴趣日益增长，基准测试工作一直受到评估任务不一致、指标异质以及对扰动类型和生物系统评估有限的影响。在此，我们提出用于跨情境扰动特征预测的基准框架（我们将该任务定义为 signature recontextualization），其基础是对预测任务、目标数据可得性以及以特征恢复为中心的评估指标作出明确界定。该框架在三种目标情境数据条件下评估预测性能：(1) 仅有对照，即只测得目标情境的对照谱；(2) 低覆盖度，即测得目标情境中有限的一部分扰动；以及 (3) 高覆盖度，即测得目标情境中大多数扰动。该设计能够系统评估预测性能如何依赖目标情境的样本量，同时为比较方法提供标准化基础。我们将新开发的基于投影的方法（projectCor）和基于网络的方法（netProp），与深度学习基础模型（scGPT、STACK）及统计学基线一同评估。该基准涵盖四个多样化扰动数据集：细胞系中的 CRISPR knockdown 和药物扰动，以及来自 DrugMatrix 的大鼠组织体内化学扰动，从而将评估从孤立的细胞系模型扩展至组织水平反应。在各项任务中，投影和网络传播方法对扰动类型与生物学情境表现出很强的适应性，并且在若干情况下达到或超过深度学习和基础模型的性能，提示模型复杂度本身并不会必然改善跨情境泛化。我们还表明，扰动的可预测性会随通路保守性、转录反应强度以及来源与目标情境之间的基线相似性而显著变化。所有数据集、方法和评估工具均以开源 R 包 sigRecon 发布，为可复现基准测试和未来方法开发提供基础。

items.title: Single-cell foundation models benefit from cross-modal training: adding proteomics data beats parameter scaling
items.abstract_or_text: Leading cellular foundation models have been trained on hundreds of millions of single-cell transcriptomes, with progress increasingly driven by larger datasets and model scaling. Here, we asked whether adding a proteomics modality can improve gene-level and cell-level representations beyond scaling RNA-only models. We introduce cross-modal continued pretraining, fine-tuning a published single-cell model (Tahoe-x1) on a large corpus of proteomic profiles. Training a 70M-parameter Tahoe-x1 model for a single epoch on 48843 proteomic samples from 440 diverse mass-spectrometry studies matched or exceeded 1B- and 3B-parameter RNA-only models across most of the original Tahoe-x1 evaluation benchmarks. This shows that with the right training recipe, heterogeneous proteomics data can improve the learned representations of single-cell RNAseq samples, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. Cross-modal pretraining also improves transfer to a held-out protein perturbation benchmark, where scaling the RNA-only model does not provide comparable benefits. These results demonstrate that careful targeted curation of proteomics data can provide larger benefits than increasing the model size alone and suggest that multimodal pretraining is a promising path toward more informative biological foundation models.
items.summary_zh: 以 440 项质谱研究的 48,843 个蛋白质组样本对 Tahoe-x1 继续预训练，交叉模态训练在多项评测中达到或超过更大的 RNA-only 模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果直接检验了单细胞基础模型的扩展路径：有针对性地引入蛋白质组信息在文中评测中比单纯增加参数更有效，并改善了未见蛋白扰动任务的迁移。
items.abstract_zh: 领先的细胞基础模型已经在数亿个单细胞转录组上训练，进展日益由更大的数据集和模型扩展推动。在此，我们询问：加入一种蛋白质组学模态能否在扩大仅 RNA 模型规模之外，改善基因层面和细胞层面的表征。我们引入交叉模态继续预训练，在大规模蛋白质组谱语料上对已发表的单细胞模型 Tahoe-x1 进行微调。一个 70M 参数的 Tahoe-x1 模型在来自 440 项多样化质谱研究的 48,843 个蛋白质组样本上训练单个 epoch 后，在原始 Tahoe-x1 评测基准的大多数项目上达到或超过了 1B 和 3B 参数的仅 RNA 模型。这表明，采用恰当训练方案时，异质蛋白质组数据能够改善单细胞 RNAseq 样本的已学习表征，并显示出很强的分布外泛化能力。交叉模态预训练还改善了向一个留出的蛋白扰动基准的迁移，而扩大仅 RNA 模型的规模未能带来可比收益。这些结果表明，细致且有针对性的蛋白质组数据整理可带来比单纯增加模型大小更大的益处，并提示多模态预训练是迈向信息更丰富的生物学基础模型的一条有前景路径。

items.title: PanoraOnc: A pan-cancer clinico-genomic AI model for transferable outcome predictions
items.abstract_or_text: Progress in precision oncology, including biomarker discovery and individualized treatment selection, is limited by the complexity of clinico-genomic data and the scarcity of large multimodal patient cohorts. Here, we introduce PanoraOnc, a pan-cancer artificial intelligence (AI) model pretrained on real-world clinical, genomic, and imaging data from 84,131 patients spanning 66 cancer types. PanoraOnc enables transferable treatment outcome prediction through pan-cancer pretraining and generalizes to unseen cohorts across cancer types, institutions, and therapeutic settings. Evaluation and fine-tuning were performed on cohorts comprising diverse modalities, including clinical features, targeted gene panels, immunofluorescence imaging, whole-exome sequencing, and transcriptomic profiles. Across these settings, PanoraOnc consistently outperforms statistical, machine-learning, survival, and AI baselines, with the largest improvements observed in zero- and few-shot scenarios, demonstrating that large-scale clinico-genomic pretraining enables robust and generalizable outcome predictions across previously unseen conditions. In addition, PanoraOnc supports biomarker discovery through explainable AI, revealing both established and underappreciated features, including tumor-infiltrating clonal hematopoiesis, oncogenic signaling pathways, and DNA damage response mechanisms in immunotherapy-treated melanoma and non-small cell lung cancer. Furthermore, PanoraOnc enables the identification of patient subgroups potentially benefitting from alternative treatments by estimating personalized treatment outcomes across therapeutic scenarios. These findings establish pan-cancer multimodal pretraining as a scalable paradigm for AI-assisted discovery in precision oncology.
items.summary_zh: PanoraOnc 在 66 种癌症、84,131 名患者的真实世界临床、基因组与影像资料上预训练，用于跨癌种治疗结局预测与可解释特征发现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其训练规模和多模态外部泛化设定使其成为精确肿瘤学中值得复核的基础模型工作；文中提出的获益亚群和生物标志物仍属于模型推断。
items.abstract_zh: 精准肿瘤学的进展，包括生物标志物发现和个体化治疗选择，受到临床基因组数据复杂性以及大型多模态患者队列稀缺的限制。在此，我们介绍 PanoraOnc：一个泛癌人工智能（AI）模型，在涵盖 66 种癌症的 84,131 名患者真实世界临床、基因组和影像数据上进行了预训练。PanoraOnc 通过泛癌预训练实现可迁移的治疗结局预测，并可泛化至不同癌种、机构和治疗场景中未见过的队列。评估和微调在包含多种模态的队列上进行，包括临床特征、靶向基因 panel、免疫荧光影像、whole-exome sequencing 和转录组谱。在这些情境中，PanoraOnc 均超过统计学、机器学习、生存分析和 AI 基线，其中最大改进出现在 zero-shot 和 few-shot 情境，表明大规模临床基因组预训练可在此前未见的条件下实现稳健且可泛化的结局预测。此外，PanoraOnc 通过可解释 AI 支持生物标志物发现，揭示了已知和此前关注不足的特征，包括接受免疫治疗的黑色素瘤和非小细胞肺癌中的肿瘤浸润性 clonal hematopoiesis、致癌信号通路和 DNA 损伤应答机制。PanoraOnc 还可通过估计不同治疗情境下的个体化治疗结局，识别可能从替代治疗中获益的患者亚群。这些发现将泛癌多模态预训练确立为 AI 辅助精准肿瘤学发现的一种可扩展范式。

items.title: Automating scientific annotations for open transcriptomic profiles via multi-stage agents
items.abstract_or_text: Public transcriptomic repositories contain millions of samples, yet their large-scale reuse is hindered by heterogeneous and inconsistently reported metadata. In the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO), key biological information is often distributed across study- and sample-level records, requiring context-dependent interpretation. Here we present GEOMeta, a large language model (LLM)-based multi-stage workflow with task-specialized agents for automated GEO metadata curation. The pipeline separates metadata retrieval, task-specific information extraction, field standardization, ontology mapping and quality control. Using GEOMeta, we generated standardized annotations for approximately 600,000 human bulk RNA-seq samples. To demonstrate its utility, we benchmarked transcriptome representation models for predicting sex, age, tissue and disease from transcriptome embeddings. We further prospectively annotated newly submitted GEO studies and evaluated 22 frontier LLMs. Recent open-source Flash models achieved annotation quality comparable to leading reasoning models while reducing costs by an order of magnitude. GEOMeta provides a scalable resource and reproducible framework for metadata curation.
items.summary_zh: GEOMeta 以多阶段 LLM 工作流为约 600,000 个人类 bulk RNA-seq 样本生成标准化 GEO 元数据，并公开流程与资源。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 高质量、可复用的样本注释是大规模转录组再利用的基础；该工作同时以新提交研究和 22 个前沿 LLM 的评估检验了注释方法。
items.abstract_zh: 公共转录组仓库包含数百万个样本，但异质且报告不一致的元数据阻碍了其大规模再利用。在 Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）中，关键生物学信息常分散于研究层面和样本层面记录之中，需要依赖语境进行解释。在此，我们提出 GEOMeta：一种基于 large language model（LLM）的多阶段工作流，使用任务专门化 agents 自动整理 GEO 元数据。该流程将元数据检索、任务特异的信息提取、字段标准化、本体映射和质量控制分开处理。利用 GEOMeta，我们为约 600,000 个人类 bulk RNA-seq 样本生成了标准化注释。为展示其用途，我们对转录组表征模型进行基准测试，用转录组 embedding 预测性别、年龄、组织和疾病。我们还以前瞻方式注释新提交的 GEO 研究，并评估了 22 个前沿 LLM。近期的开源 Flash 模型达到了可与领先推理模型相当的注释质量，同时将成本降低了一个数量级。GEOMeta 提供了可扩展资源和可复现的元数据整理框架。

items.title: The urinary-metabolite-based lung cancer index (uLCI): an interpretable machine-learning risk model for early-stage disease
items.abstract_or_text: BackgroundFive-year survival from lung cancer exceeds 60% at stage I-II but falls below 10% once metastasis occurs. Low-dose CT (LDCT) screening reduces mortality in heavy smokers but carries a false-positive rate of approximately 29% and is restricted to smoking-based eligibility, leaving most cases undetected. We aimed to develop and independently validate an interpretable machine-learning urinary metabolite risk index (uLCI) for non-invasive lung cancer detection. MethodsFour urinary metabolites--creatine riboside (CR), N-acetylneuraminic acid (NANA), 27-nor-5{beta}-cholestane-3,7,12,24R,25S-pentol (CP), and cortisol sulfate (CS)--and three clinical variables (age, race, smoking) were integrated by Lasso-regularised logistic regression into a uLCI score. The model was developed under 10-fold cross-validation in the NCI-Maryland (NCI-MD) cohort (n=845; 470 controls, 375 cases, stages I-IV) and applied without refitting to the independent Colorado Lung Cancer Cohort (n=488; 211 controls, 277 cases). Analyses were prespecified; reporting followed TRIPOD+AI. FindingsuLCI achieved an area under the curve (AUC) of 0{middle dot}906 (95% CI 0{middle dot}887-0{middle dot}926) in NCI-MD and 0{middle dot}748 (0{middle dot}701-0{middle dot}793) in the independent Colorado cohort. Scores rose monotonically across stages in both cohorts (Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}69 and 0{middle dot}45; both p<0{middle dot}0001). Stage-specific discrimination was preserved from stage I to IV (NCI-MD 0{middle dot}900-0{middle dot}927; Colorado 0{middle dot}722-0{middle dot}843). Net reclassification improvement over clinical variables was 1{middle dot}24 (1{middle dot}14-1{middle dot}36) and 0{middle dot}74 (0{middle dot}56-0{middle dot}90). uLCI tertiles stratified post-resection survival in stage I-II disease (adjusted hazard ratio 2{middle dot}03, 1{middle dot}26-3{middle dot}27). InterpretationuLCI is an independently validated, interpretable urinary risk index that detects lung cancer across all stages, with monotonic stage progression and post-resection prognostic value. Its false-positive rate compares favourably with published estimates for LDCT and cell-free-DNA assays, supporting prospective head-to-head evaluation as a non-invasive triage tool, including in screening-ineligible populations. Research in contextO_ST_ABSEvidence before this studyC_ST_ABSWe searched PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science from Jan 1, 2000, to Jan 31, 2026, without language restriction, for biomarker-based diagnostic or risk models for lung cancer, using "lung cancer", "early detection", "biomarker", "urine", "metabolite", "machine learning", "TRIPOD", and "validation in an independent cohort". Five-year survival exceeds 60% at stage I-II but falls below 10% after metastasis. Low-dose CT reduces mortality in heavy smokers but carries an approximately 29% false-positive rate and excludes never-smokers, who account for 10-25% of US lung cancers and up to 40% globally; blood-based cell-free DNA and methylation assays report rates near 27%. Most prior urinary-metabolite work, including our 2024 creatine-riboside and N-acetylneuraminic-acid report, used case-control designs without a locked, integrated model, and--even where two cohorts were analyzed--lacked prespecified independent validation or TRIPOD+AI-compliant reporting; an interpretable urinary index integrating an expanded metabolite panel with clinical variables under these standards had not been described. Added value of this studyAcross two cohorts (1333 individuals), we developed and independently validated uLCI, an interpretable Lasso-regularised logistic index combining four urinary metabolites (CR, NANA, CP, CS) with age, race, and smoking, reported to TRIPOD+AI standards. The prespecified locked model achieved an AUC of 0{middle dot}906 (95% CI 0{middle dot}887-0{middle dot}926) in NCI-MD development and 0{middle dot}748 (0{middle dot}701-0{middle dot}793) in the independent Colorado cohort without refitting, with discrimination preserved from stage I to IV (0{middle dot}900-0{middle dot}927; 0{middle dot}722-0{middle dot}843). uLCI rose monotonically with stage in both cohorts (Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}693 and 0{middle dot}449; both p<0{middle dot}0001), improved reclassification over clinical variables (net reclassification improvement 1{middle dot}24 and 0{middle dot}74), and independently stratified post-resection survival in stage I-II disease (adjusted hazard ratio 2{middle dot}03 in NCI-MD; 3{middle dot}81 in Colorado). On indirect benchmarking, the 17-19% false-positive rate was below published estimates for low-dose CT ([~]29%) and DELFI ([~]27%), and discrimination was preserved in never-smokers -- whom low-dose CT excludes -- and across racial subgroups in the diverse development cohort. Implications of all the available evidenceA locked, independently validated, non-invasive urinary index that is interpretable, accurate from stage I, stage-responsive, and prognostic after resection addresses a defined detection gap, with a plausible role as a low-cost triage test that raises pre-test probability before imaging and extends risk assessment to screening-ineligible never-smokers, complementary to low-dose CT. Prospective screening-cohort evaluation (planned in the NCI PLCO and Southern Community Cohort biobanks), head-to-head comparison with blood-based assays, recalibration to screening prevalence, and replication in diverse cohorts are the warranted next steps.
items.summary_zh: uLCI 将 4 种尿液代谢物与年龄、种族和吸烟状态结合，在 1,333 人的开发与独立队列中评估肺癌风险分层。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本使用锁定模型和独立验证，并按 TRIPOD+AI 报告；其作为筛查前分诊工具的效用仍需前瞻性人群研究与直接比较确认。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：肺癌在 I–II 期的五年生存率超过 60%，但一旦发生转移则降至 10% 以下。低剂量 CT（LDCT）筛查可降低重度吸烟者的死亡率，但其假阳性率约为 29%，且资格限制基于吸烟状况，导致大多数病例未被发现。我们的目标是开发并独立验证一种可解释的机器学习尿液代谢物风险指数（uLCI），用于无创肺癌检测。方法：将四种尿液代谢物——creatine riboside（CR）、N-acetylneuraminic acid（NANA）、27-nor-5{beta}-cholestane-3,7,12,24R,25S-pentol（CP）和 cortisol sulfate（CS）——以及三个临床变量（年龄、种族、吸烟）通过 Lasso-regularised logistic regression 整合为 uLCI 评分。该模型在 NCI-Maryland（NCI-MD）队列中采用 10-fold cross-validation 开发（n=845；470 名对照、375 例病例，I–IV 期），并在不重新拟合的条件下应用于独立 Colorado Lung Cancer Cohort（n=488；211 名对照、277 例病例）。分析预先设定；报告遵循 TRIPOD+AI。结果：uLCI 在 NCI-MD 中的 area under the curve（AUC）为 0{middle dot}906（95% CI 0{middle dot}887–0{middle dot}926），在独立 Colorado 队列中为 0{middle dot}748（0{middle dot}701–0{middle dot}793）。两个队列中的评分均随分期单调升高（Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}69 和 0{middle dot}45；均 p<0{middle dot}0001）。从 I 期至 IV 期均保留了分期特异的区分能力（NCI-MD 0{middle dot}900–0{middle dot}927；Colorado 0{middle dot}722–0{middle dot}843）。相对于临床变量的净重分类改善为 1{middle dot}24（1{middle dot}14–1{middle dot}36）和 0{middle dot}74（0{middle dot}56–0{middle dot}90）。在 I–II 期疾病中，uLCI tertiles 对切除后生存进行分层（校正 hazard ratio 2{middle dot}03，1{middle dot}26–3{middle dot}27）。解释：uLCI 是一种经过独立验证、可解释的尿液风险指数，可检测各分期肺癌，具有单调的分期进展关系和切除后的预后价值。其假阳性率优于已发表的 LDCT 和 cell-free-DNA assays 估计值，支持将其作为无创分诊工具开展前瞻性 head-to-head 评估，包括在不符合筛查资格的人群中开展评估。研究背景：本研究之前的证据：我们检索了 PubMed、Embase 和 Web of Science，自 2000 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 1 月 31 日，不限语言，检索词包括“lung cancer”“early detection”“biomarker”“urine”“metabolite”“machine learning”“TRIPOD”和“validation in an independent cohort”，以寻找肺癌的生物标志物诊断或风险模型。I–II 期肺癌的五年生存率超过 60%，而转移后低于 10%。低剂量 CT 可降低死亡率，但假阳性率约为 29%，并排除从不吸烟者；从不吸烟者占美国肺癌的 10–25%，全球可达 40%。血液 cell-free DNA 和甲基化检测报告的假阳性率接近 27%。大多数既往尿液代谢物研究，包括我们 2024 年关于 creatine-riboside 和 N-acetylneuraminic-acid 的报告，均采用病例-对照设计，缺乏锁定的整合模型；即使分析了两个队列，也未进行预先设定的独立验证或遵循 TRIPOD+AI 的报告；此前尚未描述在这些标准下整合扩展代谢物 panel 与临床变量的可解释尿液指数。本研究的附加价值：在两个队列（1,333 人）中，我们开发并独立验证了 uLCI：这是一个可解释的 Lasso-regularised logistic 指数，将四种尿液代谢物（CR、NANA、CP、CS）与年龄、种族和吸烟状况结合，并按 TRIPOD+AI 标准报告。该预先设定的锁定模型在 NCI-MD 开发队列中达到 AUC 0{middle dot}906（95% CI 0{middle dot}887–0{middle dot}926），在独立 Colorado 队列中未经重新拟合达到 0{middle dot}748（0{middle dot}701–0{middle dot}793）；从 I 期至 IV 期保留了区分能力（0{middle dot}900–0{middle dot}927；0{middle dot}722–0{middle dot}843）。uLCI 在两个队列中均随分期单调上升（Spearman {rho}=0{middle dot}693 和 0{middle dot}449；均 p<0{middle dot}0001），相对于临床变量改善重分类（净重分类改善 1{middle dot}24 和 0{middle dot}74），并独立对 I–II 期切除后生存进行分层（NCI-MD 中校正 hazard ratio 2{middle dot}03；Colorado 中为 3{middle dot}81）。在间接比较中，17–19% 的假阳性率低于已发表的低剂量 CT（[~]29%）和 DELFI（[~]27%）估计值；该指数在低剂量 CT 排除的从不吸烟者以及多样化开发队列的不同种族亚组中保持了区分能力。现有全部证据的意义：一种锁定、经独立验证、无创、可解释、从 I 期起准确、随分期变化且在切除后具有预后价值的尿液指数，填补了明确的检测空缺；它有望作为低成本分诊检测，在影像学检查前提高 pre-test probability，并扩展至不符合筛查资格的从不吸烟者，作为低剂量 CT 的补充。计划在 NCI PLCO 和 Southern Community Cohort biobanks 开展前瞻性筛查队列评估、与血液检测进行 head-to-head 比较、按筛查患病率重新校准以及在多样化队列中重复验证，这些是下一步应开展的工作。

items.title: High regeneration-associated stress defines a distinct HCC subgroup with therapeutically exploitable vulnerabilities
items.abstract_or_text: Background: To date, no precision oncology approach has been established for HCC. Despite the diverse underlying causes, HCC development exhibits a uniform pathophysiology characterised by chronic hyper-proliferation, resulting from hepatocyte apoptosis and compensatory liver regeneration. This chronic hyper-proliferative pressure, termed regeneration stress, drives genomic instability during HCC onset, yet its therapeutic potential remains poorly explored. This study aimed to identify targetable vulnerabilities tied to regeneration stress and establish clinically applicable markers for treatment stratification. Methods: Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was applied on external bulk RNA-seq datasets to define a LIVer REgeneration Stress Signature (LIVRESS). The signature was functionally validated using HCC patient-derived organoids (HCC-Org), and vulnerabilities were mapped using mid-throughput drug screening, single-molecule and single-cell assays, and multi-omic integration. Results: High LIVRESS scores, characterised by enrichment in replication, mitotic and DNA damage repair pathways, identified a subset of HCC patients with aggressive disease and poorer survival across aetiologies. HCC-Org with high LIVRESS scores displayed exquisite sensitivity to multiple inhibitors of the checkpoint kinase ATR. Although HCC-Org models exhibited a baseline reduction in replication fork speed, sensitivity to ATR inhibitor (ATRi) was decoupled from replication fork dynamics and rather linked to intrinsic mitotic instability. ATR inhibition triggers mitotic failure and apoptosis in LIVRESSHigh HCC-Org. This killing effect was significantly potentiated by combining ATRi with PARPi or WEE1i. Multi-omic integration identified KPNA2 as a surrogate biomarker of ATRi sensitivity. Conclusion: Our findings demonstrate that a subset of HCC-Org, characterised by high liver regeneration-associated stress, is vulnerable to ATRi-based therapies. By focusing on a comprehensive regenerative stress model, we establish a framework to stratify HCC patients and implement biomarker-driven, ATR-based therapies for HCC patients with advanced disease. Impact and implications: Regeneration stress is a key factor that drives genomic instability in HCC, providing a basis for the LIVRESS to identify patients dependent on ATR-mediated checkpoints. These findings reveal a conceptual shift for researchers and trialists: ATRi efficacy is decoupled from replication fork dynamics and instead leverages mitotic fragility. Practically, the LIVRESS and its IHC surrogate marker (KPNA2) offer a scalable roadmap for physicians to improve patient stratification in ATRi-based precision oncology trials. While requiring prospective validation, these results pave the way toward biomarker-driven therapies for advanced HCC.
items.summary_zh: 以 LIVRESS 表征肝细胞癌再生相关应激，并在患者来源类器官、药物筛选和多组学资料中研究其与 ATR inhibitor 敏感性的关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把可测的转录特征、KPNA2 候选替代标志物和患者来源功能实验连接起来；对患者获益与联合治疗的判断仍有待前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：迄今尚未建立肝细胞癌（HCC）的精准肿瘤学方法。尽管病因多样，HCC 的发生具有共同的病理生理学特征：由肝细胞凋亡和代偿性肝再生造成的慢性高增殖。该慢性高增殖压力被称为再生应激，在 HCC 起始过程中驱动基因组不稳定性，但其治疗潜力尚未得到充分探索。本研究旨在识别与再生应激相关、可作为靶点的易感性，并建立可用于临床治疗分层的标志物。方法：对外部 bulk RNA-seq 数据集应用 weighted gene co-expression network analysis（WGCNA），定义 LIVer REgeneration Stress Signature（LIVRESS）。在 HCC patient-derived organoids（HCC-Org）中对该特征进行功能验证，并通过中等通量药物筛选、single-molecule 和单细胞实验以及多组学整合绘制易感性图谱。结果：高 LIVRESS 评分以复制、有丝分裂和 DNA 损伤修复通路富集为特征，在不同病因中识别出一类病情更具侵袭性且生存较差的 HCC 患者。高 LIVRESS 评分的 HCC-Org 对多种 checkpoint kinase ATR inhibitors 表现出极高敏感性。尽管 HCC-Org 模型的复制叉速度基线降低，ATR inhibitor（ATRi）敏感性与复制叉动力学脱钩，反而与内在有丝分裂不稳定性相关。ATR 抑制会在 LIVRESSHigh HCC-Org 中触发有丝分裂失败和凋亡。将 ATRi 与 PARPi 或 WEE1i 联用时，该杀伤效应显著增强。多组学整合确定 KPNA2 为 ATRi 敏感性的替代生物标志物。结论：我们的发现显示，以高肝再生相关应激为特征的一部分 HCC-Org 易受 ATRi 治疗影响。通过关注综合性的再生应激模型，我们建立了对 HCC 患者进行分层并实施以生物标志物为导向的 ATR 治疗的框架。影响和意义：再生应激是驱动 HCC 基因组不稳定性的关键因素，为 LIVRESS 识别依赖 ATR 介导 checkpoints 的患者提供依据。这些结果为研究者和试验人员带来概念转变：ATRi 疗效与复制叉动力学脱钩，转而利用有丝分裂脆弱性。就实践而言，LIVRESS 及其 IHC 替代标志物 KPNA2 为临床医生在以 ATRi 为基础的精准肿瘤学试验中改进患者分层提供可扩展路线。尽管需要前瞻性验证，这些结果为晚期 HCC 患者的生物标志物导向治疗铺平了道路。

items.title: VRK1 kinase maintains an undifferentiated proliferative state in neuroblastoma tumor cells
items.abstract_or_text: Neuroblastoma is a neural crest-derived pediatric malignancy characterized by marked cellular heterogeneity and variable differentiation status. Undifferentiated tumors are associated with aggressive clinical behavior, treatment resistance and poor outcome, highlighting the need to identify molecular mechanisms that sustain tumor cell plasticity and prevent differentiation. Vaccinia-related kinase 1 (VRK1) is a serine/threonine kinase involved in cell-cycle progression, DNA-damage responses and transcriptional regulation, and has previously been associated with neuroblastoma progression. However, its role in the control of neuroblastoma differentiation remains unclear. Here, we investigated the relationship between VRK1 expression, tumor differentiation and stem-like properties in human neuroblastoma. Analysis of patient tumor datasets and tissue microarrays showed that VRK1 expression is enriched in undifferentiated neuroblastoma and stage 4 tumors, and inversely correlates with established differentiation markers, including DDC, NCAM1 and S100B. This association was maintained in MYCN-non-amplified tumors, indicating that the relationship between VRK1 and differentiation is not dependent on MYCN status. Single-cell transcriptomic analyses further demonstrated elevated VRK1 expression in developmentally immature neural crest progenitor and Schwann cell precursor-like populations. Induction of neuronal or mesenchymal differentiation consistently reduced VRK1 expression in neuroblastoma cell lines and patient-derived cells. Conversely, VRK1 silencing promoted differentiation-marker expression, reduced nestin and Ki67 expression, and produced sustained differentiation-associated changes in xenograft tumors. VRK1 was also enriched in tumorsphere cultures that select for undifferentiated stem-like neuroblastoma cells. VRK1 depletion impaired tumorsphere growth, reduced intratumoral proliferation and altered the balance between undifferentiated cells and differentiated progeny, supporting a role for VRK1 in self-renewal and maintenance of progenitor-like tumor cells. Mechanistically, VRK1 expression positively correlated with the core stemness transcription factor SOX2 in neuroblastoma tumor cells. VRK1 knockdown reduced nuclear SOX2 abundance, whereas VRK1 overexpression increased SOX2 protein levels. In addition, analysis of the VRK1 locus identified an active chromatin configuration and potential SOX2-binding sites, consistent with a regulatory relationship between these factors. Together, these findings identify VRK1 as a regulator of the undifferentiated, proliferative and stem-like state in neuroblastoma. The VRK1-SOX2 axis may contribute to stabilizing tumor-cell immaturity and represents a potential target for differentiation based therapeutic strategies in high-risk neuroblastoma.
items.summary_zh: 患者资料、单细胞数据、细胞系、患者来源细胞和异种移植实验共同提示 VRK1 与神经母细胞瘤未分化、增殖状态相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了从临床相关表达、功能性敲低到异种移植表型的连续证据，并提出 VRK1–SOX2 轴可作为分化治疗研究的候选方向。
items.abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤是一种源自神经嵴的儿童恶性肿瘤，其特征是显著的细胞异质性和可变的分化状态。未分化肿瘤与侵袭性临床行为、治疗耐药和不良结局相关，凸显出识别维持肿瘤细胞可塑性并阻止分化的分子机制的必要性。Vaccinia-related kinase 1（VRK1）是一种参与细胞周期进程、DNA 损伤应答和转录调控的 serine/threonine kinase，此前与神经母细胞瘤进展相关。然而，其在控制神经母细胞瘤分化中的作用尚不清楚。在此，我们研究了 VRK1 表达、肿瘤分化和干性样特征之间的关系。对患者肿瘤数据集和 tissue microarrays 的分析显示，VRK1 表达富集于未分化神经母细胞瘤和 4 期肿瘤，并与既定分化标志物（包括 DDC、NCAM1 和 S100B）呈负相关。这一关联在 MYCN-non-amplified 肿瘤中仍然存在，表明 VRK1 与分化之间的关系不依赖 MYCN 状态。单细胞转录组分析进一步显示，VRK1 在发育未成熟的 neural crest progenitor 和 Schwann cell precursor-like 群体中表达升高。在神经母细胞瘤细胞系和患者来源细胞中，诱导神经元或间充质分化均持续降低 VRK1 表达。相反，VRK1 silencing 促进分化标志物表达，降低 nestin 和 Ki67 表达，并在异种移植肿瘤中产生持续的分化相关变化。VRK1 在选择未分化、干性样神经母细胞瘤细胞的 tumorsphere 培养中也富集。VRK1 depletion 损害 tumorsphere 生长，降低肿瘤内增殖，并改变未分化细胞与分化子代之间的平衡，支持其在自我更新及维持祖细胞样肿瘤细胞中的作用。从机制上看，在神经母细胞瘤肿瘤细胞中，VRK1 表达与核心干性转录因子 SOX2 呈正相关。VRK1 knockdown 降低核内 SOX2 丰度，而 VRK1 overexpression 提高 SOX2 蛋白水平。此外，对 VRK1 位点的分析发现其具有活性染色质构型和潜在 SOX2-binding sites，这与两者间的调控关系相一致。综上，这些发现将 VRK1 鉴定为神经母细胞瘤未分化、增殖和干性样状态的调控因子。VRK1–SOX2 轴可能有助于稳定肿瘤细胞未成熟状态，并代表高危神经母细胞瘤中基于分化治疗策略的潜在靶点。

items.title: DEVELOPMENT OF ORGANOID BASED MODEL TO STUDY IMMUNE-NEURAL INTERACTIONS IN HUMAN CNS DISEASES
items.abstract_or_text: Modeling neural-immune interactions in neurodegenerative and immune-mediated central nervous system (CNS) diseases requires human 3D models that capture cellular diversity and long-term tissue maturation. Here, we present an enhanced human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived cerebral organoid (CO) platform optimized to mitigate core hypoxia for over 200 days. Timed pro-myelinating cues established organized neuronal layering and progressive axonal myelination through day 140, while vascular fusion yielded assembloids incorporating endothelial structures and microglia. Extended culture (>500-750 days) spontaneously reproduced hallmark features of human CNS aging, including cellular senescence signatures, neuroaxonal loss, hypomyelination, and the autonomous emergence of a neurotoxic astrocyte transcriptional profile in the complete absence of microglia or immune cells. Co-culture with autologous activated peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) resulted in transient immune infiltration and a pronounced type II interferon response across CNS lineages. High-plex spatial transcriptomics revealed that immune cell infiltration was associated with oligodendrocyte loss and in aged organoids also with downregulated oligodendrocyte myelin gene transcription. While not fully reproducing adult tissue stoichiometry, this platform enables longitudinal modeling of neural-immune crosstalk in age-related and neuroinflammatory CNS disorders.
items.summary_zh: 构建可长期培养的人 hiPSC 脑类器官与血管融合 assembloid，用于观察 CNS 老化及 PBMC 浸润相关的免疫—神经变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 超过 500–750 天的培养、血管和小胶质细胞组分以及高 plex 空间转录组，为研究人类 CNS 免疫—神经互作提供了较丰富的实验体系；其仍不能完整重现成人组织比例。
items.abstract_zh: 对神经退行性和免疫介导的中枢神经系统（CNS）疾病中的神经—免疫相互作用进行建模，需要能够捕捉细胞多样性和长期组织成熟的人类 3D 模型。在此，我们提出一个增强的人 induced pluripotent stem cell（hiPSC）来源 cerebral organoid（CO）平台，经优化后可在超过 200 天的培养中减轻中心缺氧。定时给予促髓鞘化信号，在第 140 天前建立有组织的神经元分层和渐进性轴突髓鞘化；血管融合则形成含内皮结构和小胶质细胞的 assembloids。延长培养（>500–750 天）可自发重现人类 CNS 老化的标志性特征，包括细胞衰老特征、神经轴突丢失、低髓鞘化，以及在完全没有小胶质细胞或免疫细胞时自主出现的神经毒性星形胶质细胞转录特征。与自体活化外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）共培养会导致短暂免疫浸润，并在各 CNS 谱系中引发显著的 type II interferon response。高 plex 空间转录组显示，免疫细胞浸润与少突胶质细胞丢失相关；在老化类器官中，还与少突胶质细胞髓鞘基因转录下调相关。尽管该平台不能完全重现成人组织的细胞比例，它仍可用于纵向建模年龄相关和神经炎症性 CNS 疾病中的神经—免疫 crosstalk。

items.title: Ancient human mitochondrial genomes encode antimicrobial peptides
items.abstract_or_text: Mitochondria are bacteria-derived organelles that coordinate major innate immune pathways, but whether mitochondrial genomes themselves encode direct antimicrobial functions is underexplored. Here, we test the hypothesis that ancient human mitochondrial DNA is not only an evolutionary record, but also contains encrypted peptide sequences with the capacity to contribute to host defense. Because mitochondria descend from a bacterial endosymbiont and retain bacterial-like molecular features, we reasoned that their compact genomes might preserve sequence fragments capable of engaging bacterial-like membranes or bacterial physiology. We mined 2,025 ancient human mitochondrial genomes using a computational pipeline that couples ORF extraction and deep learning, identifying 65 candidate peptides that we term mitochondrins. We synthesized 38 candidates and experimentally validated 14 as antimicrobials against clinically relevant Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria. Active mitochondrins were not defined by length, charge, or helicity alone; instead, potency depended on precise hydrophobic-cationic patterning, with nested peptide families revealing how single motif-level changes can switch activity on or off. Mechanistic assays showed that mitochondrins span multiple antibacterial modalities, from strong membrane disruption to potent activity with limited membrane perturbation, suggesting noncanonical or multi-step killing mechanisms. Several peptides displayed low cytotoxicity toward human cells, and one representative mitochondrin reduced bacterial burden in a murine skin abscess model. These findings provide a biochemical basis for the hypothesis that mitochondrial genomes may contribute to innate immunity.
items.summary_zh: 从 2,025 份古代人类线粒体基因组中筛出 mitochondrins；合成的 38 条候选肽中有 14 条在实验中表现出抗菌活性，代表肽还在小鼠皮肤脓肿模型中降低细菌负荷。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把大规模计算筛选、肽合成、机制实验、细胞毒性测试和体内感染模型结合起来，为线粒体编码肽的宿主防御功能提出可实验检验的证据。
items.abstract_zh: 线粒体是源自细菌的细胞器，协调主要的先天免疫通路，但线粒体基因组本身是否编码直接的抗菌功能仍未得到充分探索。在此，我们检验如下假说：古代人类线粒体 DNA 不仅是进化记录，还含有可能有助于宿主防御的加密肽序列。由于线粒体源自细菌内共生体并保留细菌样分子特征，我们推断其紧凑基因组可能保留能够与细菌样膜或细菌生理过程发生作用的序列片段。我们利用结合 ORF 提取和深度学习的计算流程挖掘了 2,025 份古代人类线粒体基因组，鉴定出 65 条候选肽，称为 mitochondrins。我们合成了其中 38 条候选肽，并在实验中验证 14 条对临床相关 Gram-negative 和 Gram-positive 细菌具有抗菌活性。活性 mitochondrins 并不由长度、电荷或螺旋性单独定义；相反，效力取决于精确的疏水—阳离子模式，嵌套肽家族揭示单个 motif 水平变化如何能开启或关闭活性。机制实验显示，mitochondrins 覆盖多种抗菌模式，从强烈膜破坏到仅有有限膜扰动却具有强效活性的模式，提示存在非经典或多步骤杀菌机制。若干肽对人细胞显示低细胞毒性，一条代表性 mitochondrin 在小鼠皮肤脓肿模型中降低了细菌负荷。这些发现为线粒体基因组可能有助于先天免疫这一假说提供了生化依据。

items.title: DNA gyrase in live bacteria forms liquid condensates through weak multivalent bonding of excess GyrB
items.abstract_or_text: Type IIA bacterial topoisomerase DNA gyrase, a GyrA/GyrB heterotetramer, has crucial roles maintaining transcription and DNA replication by relaxing positive DNA supercoils through introducing negative supercoils. However, rates of gyrase-catalysed supercoiling in vitro cannot explain much higher rates required in vivo. To address this puzzle, we used high-speed single-molecule fluorescence imaging of GyrA/GyrB reporters in live Escherichia coli, indicating that cells contain [~]40% more GyrB than GyrA expressed in a diffuse pool or in clusters whose mobility depends on whether they are bound to DNA. Unexpectedly, we discovered that clusters are non-stoichiometric containing [~]150% more GyrB than GyrA, significantly greater than the cellular average, with fluorescence recovery after photobleaching revealing that clustered GyrA and GyrB behave as a liquid whose abundance can be increased by applying gyrase-targeting antibiotics. Structural docking indicates that the liquid state is stabilised through excess GyrB progressively binding to existing clusters via weak, multivalent interactions. By operating in liquid condensates, A2B2 that dissociates from DNA can rebind rapidly instead of diffusing away, increasing enzyme processivity to enable multiple rounds of catalysis that can keep pace with transcription and DNA replication in vivo. This demonstrates a new role for condensates of overcoming kinetic limitations imposed by diffusion. items.summary_zh: 活细胞单分子荧光成像显示，大肠杆菌 DNA gyrase 的 GyrA/GyrB 可形成富含 GyrB 的液态凝聚体，并提出其提高酶过程性的机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究以定量活细胞成像、FRAP 和结构 docking 解释体内 gyrase 活性为何可超过体外速率估计，为细菌 DNA 拓扑调控补充了凝聚体机制。
items.abstract_zh: IIA 型细菌 topoisomerase DNA gyrase 是一个 GyrA/GyrB heterotetramer，通过引入负 supercoils 来松弛正 DNA supercoils，在维持转录和 DNA 复制中发挥关键作用。然而，体外 gyrase 催化 supercoiling 的速率无法解释体内所需的高得多的速率。为解决这一难题，我们在活 Escherichia coli 中使用 GyrA/GyrB reporters 进行高速单分子荧光成像，结果显示细胞中表达的 GyrB 比 GyrA 多 [~]40%，其存在于弥散 pool 或 clusters 中，clusters 的移动性取决于它们是否与 DNA 结合。出乎意料的是，我们发现 clusters 是非化学计量的，所含 GyrB 比 GyrA 多 [~]150%，显著高于细胞平均值；fluorescence recovery after photobleaching 显示 clustered GyrA 和 GyrB 的行为如同液体，且可通过施加靶向 gyrase 的抗生素增加其丰度。结构 docking 表明，液态由过量 GyrB 通过弱的多价相互作用逐步结合到已有 clusters 而稳定。通过在液态凝聚体中运行，从 DNA 解离的 A2B2 能够快速重新结合而非扩散离去，从而增加酶的过程性，使其可进行多轮催化并跟上体内转录和 DNA 复制。这表明凝聚体具有克服扩散造成的动力学限制的新作用。
items.author_line: Syeda, A. H., Hollands, K., Frame, L., Shepherd, J., Payne-Dwyer, A., Goffee, E., Burton, N., Basu, A., Noy, A., Maxwell, A., Leake, M. C.

items.title: A contextualised protein language model reveals the functional syntax of bacterial evolution
items.abstract_or_text: Bacteria have evolved a vast diversity of functions and behaviours that are currently incompletely understood and poorly predicted from DNA sequence alone. To understand the syntax of bacterial evolution and discover genome-to-phenotype relationships, we curated over 1.3 million genomes spanning bacterial phylogenetic space, represented each as an ordered sequence of proteins, and used these sequences to train a transformer-based, contextualised protein language model, Bacformer. By pretraining on genome-wide evolutionary patterns, Bacformer captures the compositional and positional relationships of proteins and thereby provides a whole-genome framework for linking genomic organisation and content to measurable bacterial traits. We demonstrate the ability of Bacformer to accurately predict protein-protein interactions; uncover operon structure, which we validated experimentally; infer important phenotypic traits, including antimicrobial resistance, while revealing likely causal genes; and design template synthetic proteomes with desirable properties. Thus, Bacformer establishes a genomic foundation model that reveals the evolutionary rules governing bacterial gene organisation, function, and phenotype, opening a route to systematic whole-genome engineering.
items.summary_zh: Bacformer 在逾 130 万个细菌基因组的有序蛋白序列上训练，以全基因组语境预测蛋白互作、operon、表型和合成蛋白组。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模覆盖广泛细菌系统发育空间，并包含对 operon 推断的实验验证；文中关于 AMR 与候选因果基因的结论仍应按其模型和验证范围解读。
items.abstract_zh: 细菌已经演化出大量目前尚未被充分理解、也难以仅凭 DNA 序列预测的功能和行为。为理解细菌进化的语法并发现基因组到表型的关系，我们整理了跨越细菌系统发育空间的逾 130 万个基因组，将每个基因组表示为有序的蛋白序列，并使用这些序列训练了一个基于 transformer 的、语境化 protein language model——Bacformer。通过在全基因组进化模式上预训练，Bacformer 捕捉蛋白的组成和位置关系，因而提供了将基因组组织与内容同可测量细菌性状联系起来的全基因组框架。我们展示了其准确预测 protein-protein interactions 的能力；它发现了我们通过实验验证的 operon 结构；能够推断包括 antimicrobial resistance 在内的重要表型，同时揭示可能的 causal genes；并可设计具有理想性质的模板合成蛋白组。因此，Bacformer 建立了一个基因组基础模型，揭示支配细菌基因组织、功能和表型的进化规则，为系统性全基因组工程开辟了路径。
items.author_line: Wiatrak, M., Abelson, D. C., Mikhaylenko, R., Vinas Torne, R., Ntemourtsidou, M., Dinan, A., Arora, D., Horsfield, S. T., Lees, J., Brbic, M., Weimann, A., Andres Floto, R.

items.title: PerturbLDM: conditional latent diffusion for modelling single-cell perturbation responses
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell perturbation profiling maps intervention-induced phenotypes, yet experiments measure only a fraction of the perturbation-context space. Learning context-dependent perturbation effects could enable response prediction beyond measured conditions. Here we introduce PerturbLDM, a latent-diffusion framework for conditional generation of single-cell transcriptional responses. Following Tahoe-100M pretraining, it predicted 13,942 held-out combinations of observed drugs, doses and cell lines more accurately than existing methods, with higher matched-control effect correlation than an additive marginal baseline in 95.2% of conditions. The Tahoe-100M-pretrained model was further used to rank PANACEA compounds by pathway similarity, placing shared-mechanism pairs among nearest neighbours. In smaller datasets, Per-turbLDM generated a mid-gestational fetal-colon state with 67% lower gene-wise error than Squidiff, retaining the balance between absorptive and BEST4/OTOP2-like epithelial programmes. In PBMCs, it captured six of seven interferon and antiviral programmes and the interferon-associated FAO-OXPHOS programme more accurately than scGen. Together, these results support conditional response generation across data scales and biological settings.
items.summary_zh: PerturbLDM 用 Tahoe-100M 预训练的条件 latent diffusion 生成单细胞扰动反应，在多种药物、剂量、细胞系和生物体系中与既有方法比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对 13,942 个留出组合、胎儿结肠和 PBMC 的评估表明其具备跨情境预测潜力；模型生成结果仍需与新实验扰动逐项核实。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞扰动 profiling 绘制干预诱导的表型，但实验仅测量扰动—情境空间的一小部分。学习依赖情境的扰动效应，可能使人们能够预测超出已测量条件的反应。在此，我们提出 PerturbLDM：一个用于条件生成单细胞转录反应的 latent-diffusion 框架。在 Tahoe-100M 预训练后，它对 13,942 个由已观测药物、剂量和细胞系构成的留出组合的预测优于既有方法，并且在 95.2% 的条件下，其 matched-control effect correlation 高于加性边缘基线。经 Tahoe-100M 预训练的模型还用于按通路相似性对 PANACEA compounds 排名，将共享机制的配对置于最近邻之中。在较小数据集中，PerturbLDM 生成的 mid-gestational fetal-colon state 的逐基因误差比 Squidiff 低 67%，同时保留吸收性与 BEST4/OTOP2-like epithelial programmes 的平衡。在 PBMC 中，它比 scGen 更准确地捕捉了七个 interferon 和 antiviral programmes 中的六个，以及 interferon-associated FAO-OXPHOS programme。综上，这些结果支持在不同数据规模和生物学情境下开展条件反应生成。
items.author_line: Yu, L., Hsieh, K.-L., Chu, Y., Lan, Q., Zhao, X., Hsu, Y.-C., Wood, C. S., Rasmy, L., Pilie, P. G., Zhi, D., Zhao, Z., Jiang, X., Dai, Y.

items.title: CLEAR-ST: Physics-informed probabilistic decontamination of spatial transcriptomics by modeling mRNA lateral diffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics is a rapidly evolving technology that allows for the measurement of gene expression in a spatially resolved manner. However, one technical problem that occurs for many sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics platforms is the presence of mRNA lateral diffusion, where mRNA from one spot can bind to probes in another spot, leading to contamination and inaccurate gene expression measurements. In Visium-like assays, this artifact is often visible as structured out-of-tissue signal and boundary-associated expression halos, yet its magnitude, spatial decay, and directional bias vary substantially across samples. Here, we present CLEAR-ST, a physics-informed probabilistic framework for correcting diffusion-like contamination in spatial transcriptomics data. CLEAR-ST infers a latent clean expression field using a denoising autoencoder and links it to the observed counts through a graph-Laplacian forward contamination model with learnable diffusion parameters, finally evaluated with a selectable count likelihood. We first conducted a comprehensive comparison between 10X official and independently generated Visium samples, demonstrating that out-of-tissue count profiles are highly related to nearby in-tissue expression, more concentrated near tissue boundaries, and diffusion directions across genes are likely coherent. Across real samples with varying contamination burden, CLEAR-ST improved spatial domain recovery, increased gene-level spatial autocorrelation, and enhanced the biological specificity of downstream analyses such as marker gene discovery, pathway identification and cell type deconvolution. Compared to benchmark methods, CLEAR-ST showed consistent gains in clustering quality and concordance with manual annotations. Together, CLEAR-ST provides an interpretable and practical approach for diffusion-aware correction of capture-based spatial transcriptomics data.
items.summary_zh: CLEAR-ST 以 mRNA 横向扩散的图 Laplacian 前向污染模型校正空间转录组污染，并在多种 Visium 样本中评估下游改善。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把可解释的物理污染假设与概率模型结合，并与 10X 官方及独立生成样本和多种基准方法比较，有助于提高空间结果的技术可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学是一项快速发展的技术，可对具有空间分辨率的基因表达进行测量。然而，许多测序型空间转录组平台存在一个技术问题：mRNA 横向扩散，即一个 spot 的 mRNA 与另一 spot 的 probes 结合，导致污染和不准确的基因表达测量。在 Visium-like assays 中，这一伪影常表现为组织外的结构化信号以及组织交界附近的表达光晕；但其大小、空间衰减和方向偏倚在样本间差异很大。在此，我们提出 CLEAR-ST：一个用于校正空间转录组中扩散样污染的 physics-informed probabilistic framework。CLEAR-ST 使用 denoising autoencoder 推断潜在的清洁表达场，并通过具有可学习扩散参数的 graph-Laplacian forward contamination model 将其与观测 counts 联系起来，最后以可选择的 count likelihood 进行评估。我们首先对 10X 官方和独立生成的 Visium 样本进行了全面比较，结果显示组织外 count profiles 与附近组织内表达高度相关，在组织交界附近更集中，并且各基因的扩散方向可能一致。在污染负荷不同的真实样本中，CLEAR-ST 改善了空间 domain recovery，增加了基因层面的空间自相关，并增强 marker gene discovery、pathway identification 和 cell type deconvolution 等下游分析的生物学特异性。与基准方法相比，CLEAR-ST 在聚类质量和与人工注释的一致性方面获得稳定提升。综上，CLEAR-ST 为 capture-based spatial transcriptomics data 提供了一种可解释且实用的、具扩散感知能力的校正方法。
items.author_line: Ma, K., Huang, Y., Ho, J. W. K.

items.title: RegFM: an interpretable context-aware foundation model for human transcriptional regulation
items.abstract_or_text: Transcriptional regulation is governed by interactions between cis-regulatory elements (CREs) and trans-acting regulators in a context-specific manner. Although DNA and single-cell foundation models have enabled modeling regulatory biology at scale, most represent either sequence or cellular state alone, limiting their ability to capture context-dependent gene regulation. Here we present RegFM, a context-aware foundation model for human transcriptional regulation. RegFM treats transcriptional regulation as a dialogue between cis-regulatory sequences (e.g., CREs) and trans-acting regulators (e.g., transcription factors (TFs) and chromatin regulators (CRs)) by coupling long-range CRE representations with TFs and CRs activity. Trained on large-scale ENCODE and CELLxGENE transcriptomic profiles, RegFM learns gene-centered regulatory representations that generalize across unseen cellular contexts. In a wide range of tasks, including gene expression prediction, cis-regulatory element annotation, bivalent promoter and dosage-sensitivity classification, and perturbation-response prediction, RegFM consistently improves over existing methods. RegFM emerges as a scalable and interpretable framework for modeling human transcriptional regulation and provides insights into context-dependent gene regulatory programs.
items.summary_zh: RegFM 将远程 cis-regulatory elements 表征与 TF、chromatin regulators 活性结合，以语境感知方式建模人类转录调控。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型同时涵盖序列与细胞状态，并在表达预测、CRE 注释、双价启动子、剂量敏感性和扰动反应等任务中评测，为可解释调控建模提供统一思路。
items.abstract_zh: 转录调控由 cis-regulatory elements（CREs）与 trans-acting regulators 在特定语境中的相互作用支配。尽管 DNA 和单细胞基础模型已经能够大规模建模调控生物学，多数模型只表征序列或细胞状态之一，限制了其捕捉依赖语境的基因调控的能力。在此，我们提出用于人类转录调控的语境感知基础模型 RegFM。RegFM 将转录调控视为 cis-regulatory sequences（如 CREs）与 trans-acting regulators（如 transcription factors（TFs）和 chromatin regulators（CRs））之间的对话：它将远程 CRE 表征与 TF 和 CR 活性耦合。RegFM 在大规模 ENCODE 和 CELLxGENE 转录组谱上训练，学习以基因为中心的调控表征，并可泛化至未见的细胞语境。在包括 gene expression prediction、cis-regulatory element annotation、bivalent promoter 和 dosage-sensitivity classification 以及 perturbation-response prediction 在内的广泛任务中，RegFM 均稳定优于现有方法。RegFM 是一个可扩展且可解释的人类转录调控建模框架，并为理解依赖语境的基因调控程序提供见解。
items.author_line: Gao, Z., Sun, Y., Wang, H., Jiang, R., Liu, Q.

items.title: Phenotype-associated spatial biomarker discovery in spatial transcriptomics with spHOT
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics now profiles patient cohorts at single-cell resolution, enabling analysis of disease-associated cell organization in situ. However, discovering such spatial biomarkers remains challenging because relevant structures occur at unknown scales and cell-or niche-level annotations are rarely available. We present spHOT, a deep learning framework that localizes phenotype-associated spatial biomarkers from sample-level labels. spHOT combines spatial foundation model embeddings, a hierarchical domain tree for multi-resolution tissue representation, and a teacher-student multiple instance learning architecture that converts sample labels into cell-level biomarker scores. In controlled simulations and real-tissue benchmarks, spHOT outperformed existing spatial and single-cell methods in localizing ground-truth biomarkers. Across fibrotic, metabolic, and autoimmune disease datasets, spHOT recovered disease-relevant niches and tissue states reported by supervised analyses in the original studies. Cross-disease application of spHOT transferred biomarkers across chronic lung diseases without retraining. spHOT enables scalable, annotation-efficient spatial biomarker discovery in cohort-scale spatial transcriptomics.
items.summary_zh: spHOT 从样本级表型标签中定位空间生物标志物，结合空间基础模型 embedding、多分辨组织树和 teacher-student multiple instance learning。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对空间队列中常缺少细胞或生态位标签的问题，在模拟、真实组织和跨疾病迁移中进行评测，可支持更高通量的空间标志物发现。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学如今可在单细胞分辨率下对患者队列进行 profiling，使得人们能够原位分析疾病相关的细胞组织方式。然而，发现此类空间生物标志物仍然困难，因为相关结构出现于未知尺度，并且细胞或生态位层面的注释很少可得。我们提出 spHOT：一个从样本级标签定位表型相关空间生物标志物的深度学习框架。spHOT 将 spatial foundation model embeddings、用于多分辨率组织表征的 hierarchical domain tree，以及将样本标签转换为细胞层面生物标志物评分的 teacher-student multiple instance learning architecture 相结合。在受控模拟和真实组织基准中，spHOT 在定位 ground-truth biomarkers 方面优于既有空间和单细胞方法。在纤维化、代谢性和自身免疫疾病数据集中，spHOT 恢复了原始研究中由监督分析报告的疾病相关生态位和组织状态。spHOT 的跨疾病应用可在无需重新训练的情况下，在慢性肺病之间迁移生物标志物。spHOT 使队列尺度空间转录组中的空间生物标志物发现具有可扩展性且对注释要求更低。
